pharmacology.text: Diphenylprolinol (D2PM), or (R/S)-(±)-diphenyl-2-pyrrolidinyl-methanol, is a norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor which is used as a designer drug.

uses.text: Diphenylprolinol (D2PM), or (R/S)-(±)-diphenyl-2-pyrrolidinyl-methanol, is a norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor which is used as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 二苯基脯氨醇（英語：Diphenylprolinol 或 --diphenyl-2-pyrrolidinyl-methanol，縮寫D2PM）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C17H19NO，能作為去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制劑。
summaryZhHans: 二苯基脯氨醇（英语：Diphenylprolinol 或 --diphenyl-2-pyrrolidinyl-methanol，缩写D2PM）是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C17H19NO，能作为去甲肾上腺素-多巴胺再吸收抑制剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of its kind can cause sleeplessness, restlessness, anxiety, a fast heartbeat, high blood pressure and loss of appetite, and can lead to dependence. High amounts can cause overheating, paranoia, psychosis and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦慮、心跳加快、血壓升高與食慾減退，並可能導致依賴。大量使用可能造成體溫過高、妄想、精神病症狀與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能造成失眠、坐立不安、焦虑、心跳加快、血压升高与食欲减退，并可能导致依赖。大量使用可能造成体温过高、妄想、精神病症状与癫痫发作。

fact.en: Diphenylprolinol is better known to chemists as a tool: it and its close relatives are used as catalysts to make one mirror-image form of a molecule rather than the other.
fact.zh: 化學家更熟悉的是把二苯基脯胺醇當作工具：它和它的近親被用作催化劑，讓反應只生成分子的其中一種鏡像形式。
fact.zhHans: 化学家更熟悉的是把二苯基脯胺醇当作工具：它和它的近亲被用作催化剂，让反应只生成分子的其中一种镜像形式。
